answer: The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
